foodImportReview: Decision 69/2024, effective 1 January 2025, Article 3(1) expressly exempts food imported for personal use from food-product registration. This is not a waiver of agricultural quarantine or every food clearance requirement. Food Safety Law 84/2008 Article 12 directs Customs to obtain competent-authority health/agricultural/veterinary release; its text alone does not establish an exporter-supplied certificate or advance personal application. The current 2025 amendment to regulation Article 30 allows pre-licence verification of foreign food establishments, but the underlying Article 30 and its private-parcel scope could not be reliably extracted in this pass. No independent blanket special-document barrier was established.

rule: Current Agricultural Quarantine Law 24/2005 Article 2 requires an import licence and exporting-country phytosanitary certificate for covered consignments from outside the GCC, with authority-set risk-based exceptions. The implementing rules qualify manufactured plant products by pest risk and explicitly cover postal parcels. Japan MAFF postal manufactured tea is PQ*11. Separately, the GCC food-import guide published by Qatar Customs exempts personal-use food from general food-document requirements when adequate packaging and identifying information are supplied.
